Name: Mystical Fish
Author: debaucherousdemon95
Description:
Bring a little magic to your next fishing trip. Mystical Fish adds five mystical
fish, each with its own catch conditions, eating buff, and matching cooked meal.

FEATURES
- Moonveil Koi, Starfire Betta, Dreamglass Minnow, Thornscale Guardian, and Voidfin Eel.
- Different seasons, weather, fishing levels, and difficulties.
- Fishing, Speed, Luck, Defense, and Mining food buffs.
- Five custom recipes, each using one matching fish and one Oil.
- Support for vanilla any-fish recipes, fish ponds, roe, and fish tanks.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55117/55117-1793959685-1143394876.png[/img]

[color=#f1c232]Future Plans:[/color] 
Add more fish
Add more buffs
Improve the sprites of placed food/placed fish. Need to upscale the quality a little.
Nerf a few things...
